notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a card type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
Cast Shifting Loyalties by paying {5}{U}, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
